model: Real OpenOil/OpenDrift (opendrift==1.14.11), NOT this project's own locked model

physics.coastline: real GSHHG coastline (OpenOil default 'stranding'), not this project's CMEMS-mask proxy
physics.stokes_drift: nominally True (OpenOil default) but functionally inert -- no wave reader attached

notes: This is a SEPARATE exploratory deliverable using the real OpenOil/OpenDrift engine with weathering and diffusion enabled -- it does NOT replace or modify this project's own locked, from-scratch, deterministic model under output/.
Non-deterministic by nature (diffusion + current/wind uncertainty); reproducible only because a fixed random_seed was passed to OpenOil.

Per-parcel mass_kg heterogeneity is not individually preserved -- OpenOil has no concept of per-element user-supplied mass (confirmed from its own source: mass_oil is marked 'seed': False and unconditionally recomputed during seeding). The real TOTAL observed mass (sum of all parcels' mass_kg) was seeded correctly and verified numerically, then split equally across parcels and weathered realistically from there.
